voxa_describe: VOXA is a powerful editor for creating voxel models. It comes along with the skeleton system, which you can add animation to your models and make them alive! You can decorate your Land with models or list them on CREATERA's marketplace and make profits.
arena_describe: ARENA is the map editor where you can create a 3D virtual world at your will. It supports real-time collaboration, so you can build and run your world with like-minded friends.
workflow_text_1: Draw and create a voxel model
workflow_text_2: Drag and drop 3d models into a createra scene
workflow_text_3: Design experience by adding interactivity to arranged scene and models
workflow_text_4: Attract more followers who enjoy your experience to form your own community!
workflow_text_5: Deploy experience into your land to get more exposure and make profit
creator_concept_describe: Let us see how amazing creators could be...
story1_message_1: When Box.Game first appeared on Codemao's homepage in 2019, I was drawn to its multiplayer feature and became one of the first players. After a year, I discovered the creation tools. My programming skills were limited then, but by studying the API and with help from others, I created 'Animal Life Simulator'.
story1_message_2: In 2022, my friends and I founded 'Hengguang Academy'. What captivated me most about Box.Game was its ability to connect like-minded people. The friends I made there gave me immense support, and many became part of our team.
story1_message_3: My real strength is planning. Inspiration drives me, and passion is its source—something I hope everyone can find.
story2_message_1: Six years ago, I was deeply impressed by magnificent maps, which sparked my desire to create. After gaining editing permissions, I completed my first work, 'The City in Hope.' It was rough but incredibly meaningful.
story2_message_2: Later, I joined the 'Sky God's Domain' team. The sense of accomplishment when our three works were featured on the homepage is still unforgettable. This experience taught me the power of teamwork and introduced me to many partners.
story2_message_3: Through my journey in Box.Game, my building skills, logical thinking, and collaboration have all significantly improved. In these six years, I have not only built virtual worlds but also gained growth and friendship. I look forward to creating more in the future!
story3_message_1: I started as a newcomer, just playing popular maps. After getting building permissions, I began making small, simple structures and enjoyed it. I didn't know any code, but with help from friends, I started a journey of collaborative creation.
story3_message_2: I joined a team, and our work got featured on the homepage, boosting my confidence. Later, with a more professional team, we earned the 'Creator of the Year' title and built the highly-acclaimed 'Hengguang Academy'.
story3_message_3: When Box.Game launched, I began exploring the model editor. I shared my process on Bilibili and got a like from the official account, which felt like my growth was being recognized. From a newbie to completing complex projects, every step has been slow but solid.
c_story1_message: Arena is easier to acquire among the tools I have used. For me, Arena's game coding function is highly utilized to make realistic games, and it is a great accomplishment to be able to implement the gameplay you want. Plus, it would be great to have a model of a torch or fence that you can use directly!
c_story2_message: Our studio used Arena tool to create the map 'Parkour Casino'. The map features a combination of casino elements such as poker, mahjong and chips, with a modern architectural style. After three weeks of creation, we were able to create the scenarios we were expecting in reality, and even play in the scenarios as we dreamed. At the same time, I also realize that we are a team. The team needs efforts of all members, and the members cannot thrive without the team.
c_story3_message: I am a newbie with no know-how in coding. It took me less than one month to make the game I want with Arena. Although it is not perfect, I am really happy to finish this game work. What makes me most happy is that there is a relatively complete tutorial and basic code that I can use directly, which makes my whole creation process relatively smooth.
